notes: Openspec provided empty acceptance criteria with only a diagnostic note. I created the full AC set from scratch based on the story context and listed files. Key additions: (1) ACs 1-4 cover the core defect for return trips with both percentage and fixed discounts, plus a one-way regression guard. (2) AC 5 covers the no-promo-code baseline. (3) AC 6 addresses the edge case where discount exceeds price. (4) AC 7 targets the suspected root cause — discount data loss during the station-swap transformation in create-reservations.mappers.ts. (5) AC 8 ensures end-to-end consistency between the reservation report and the webhook/email payload. (6) AC 9 covers the edge case of promo code expiry between booking and confirmation. (7) AC 10 covers the return-trip modification path via map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts. All ACs are written as observable outcomes (Given/When/Then) with no implementation instructions.

after.description: [Mozio] - The Promo code amount is NOT displayed as expected for Return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation. When a promo/discount code is applied to an order containing return trip tickets, the discount amount fails to appear (or appears incorrectly) in the Mozio email confirmation for those return trip dispatches, while one-way trip dispatches display it correctly.
after.title: [Mozio] - Promo code amount not displayed for Return trip tickets in Mozio email confirmation

notes: Story arrived with empty acceptanceCriteria — openspec is now providing the primary AC set derived from the description. The defect is that promo/discount amounts are missing from return-trip dispatches in the Mozio email confirmation while one-way dispatches display them correctly. Root cause likely lies in the return-trip dispatch construction path (create-reservations.mappers.ts / apply-report-discounts.service.ts / map-line-item-return-trip-modification.ts) where discount data from the report is either not propagated or overwritten for return-trip dispatches. The sanitized mapper (map-to-sanitized-mozio-dispatch.ts) correctly maps discount when present, so the issue is upstream in how the report.price.discount is populated for return trips.
